title: Production Docker box with hidden exposure
traps: ufw is active and allows only 22/80, but Docker publishes Postgres 5432 and Adminer 8081 on 0.0.0.0 straight past ufw
PasswordAuthentication yes comes from 50-cloud-init.conf; PermitRootLogin yes from a legacy drop-in
an unknown old SSH key sits in root's authorized_keys
automatic security updates are switched off
